requirements.requirement: The system must map 'Phase I' to a numeric score lower than 'Phase II', 'Phase III', and 'Phase IV'.
The system must map 'Phase II' to a numeric score higher than 'Phase I' and lower than 'Phase III' and 'Phase IV'.
The system must map 'Phase III' to a numeric score higher than 'Phase II' and lower than 'Phase IV'.
The system must map 'Phase IV' to the highest numeric score among all defined phase values.
The system must return a normalized numeric score within a fixed bounded range for all valid phase inputs.
The system must produce deterministic output such that identical phase inputs always yield the same numeric score.
The system must handle composite phase values (e.g., 'Phase I/II') by assigning a score between the individual phase scores.
The system must treat phase input values case-insensitively when performing the mapping.
The system must return a defined default score when the phase value is 'N/A'.
The system must return a defined default score when the phase value is missing or null.
The system must return a defined default score when the phase value is not recognized among supported inputs.
The system must not throw an unhandled exception for any invalid, malformed, or unexpected phase input.
The system must expose the mapping logic as a callable function within clinical_trials_service.
The system must execute the phase-to-score mapping in constant time without external service calls.
